T: Extra, extra, eat all about it.
D: Newsboys go on strike against Pulitzer in 1899 New York.
P: Serve the mains when the strike starts.
S: a penny snack on the street corner
Pretzel dough shaped, 30 seconds in a baking soda bath, coarse salt, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.
Corn boiled 5 minutes, then charred on a grill and rolled in butter and salt.
the boys' breakfast before selling papes
Soft milk rolls warmed at 180C for 5 minutes, split, with salted butter and strawberry jam.
M: Franks griddled until blistered, in soft steamed buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in newspaper.
the boys' dinner at the lodging house
Lamb neck chops browned, layered with potato, onion and carrot, stock poured over, braised covered at 160C for 2 hours. Parsley.
W: Puff pastry squares filled with apple cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, folded, egg-washed and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.

edition.tagline: Extra, extra, eat all about it.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when the strike starts.

s.note: Golden soft pretzels with a crisp crust and coarse salt.
s.how: Mix 250g bread flour, 4g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp fine salt and 160ml warm water. Knead 8 minutes and rise covered for 1 hour. Shape into four small pretzels. Bring 1 litre water with 30g bicarbonate of soda to a simmer and bathe each pretzel for 30 seconds. Drain onto a lined tray, sprinkle with 1 tsp coarse salt and bake at 220°C conventional for 12 minutes until deep golden.

s.note: Boiled then charred corn rolled in butter and flaky salt.
s.how: Boil 4 small corn cobs in water for 5 minutes. Drain, then char on a hot grill for 5 to 7 minutes, turning often. Roll in 30g softened butter and sprinkle with 1/2 tsp sea salt flakes. Serve one cob each.

m.note: Blistered franks in steamed buns with mustard and tangy sauerkraut.
m.how: Griddle 8 hot dog franks over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until blistered and piping hot. Steam 8 soft hot dog buns for 1 to 2 minutes until warm. Fill each bun with a frank, 1 tsp yellow mustard and a spoonful from 200g drained sauerkraut. Wrap in food-safe newspaper-style paper or baking paper. Serve two each.

w.note: Golden puff pastry parcels filled with buttery cinnamon apples.
w.how: Peel, core and dice 400g apples. Cook with 20g butter, 40g caster sugar and 1/2 tsp cinnamon over medium heat for 10 minutes until tender and fairly dry. Cool. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into four squares each. Divide filling among the squares, fold diagonally and seal the edges. Brush with 1 beaten egg. Bake at 200°C conventional for 20 minutes until golden. Serve two small turnovers each.

d.note: Ice-cold sarsaparilla, a penny drink at the strike rally.
d.how: Chill 1.2L sarsaparilla soda for at least 2 hours. Pour into 4 tall glasses over ice, and add a small scoop of vanilla ice cream to any glass where someone wants it turned into a float.
